rows.value: Every addressable location across Great Britain
rows.evidence: A UPRN identifies an addressable location; it is not a broadband measurement.
Includes residential, commercial and some non-postal features.
Snapshot/version must be pinned for reproducible joins.
Format availability does not mean bytes were hydrated in the approved runtime.
Authority applies to identifier assignment, not broadband service.

rows.value: Properties plus features such as bus shelters and substations
rows.evidence: A UPRN record cannot be assumed to be a dwelling or business premises.
An identifier relationship is not an exact registered-title boundary.
Current release bytes and relationship rows remain required before use.
NSUL supports geography lookup and does not provide broadband values.
Higher-geography allocation is separate from title-boundary matching.

rows.value: Included since October 2020 where AddressBase postcode is in Code-Point Open
rows.evidence: ONS also states there is no formal agreement governing postcode inclusion.
New files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
Leasehold and other tenures are not represented in this open subset.

rows.value: A polygon may appear in both local-authority files
rows.evidence: Exact Land Registry-INSPIRE ID deduplication is required.
Exact title extent can only be identified from the individual title plan.

rows.value: BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15 metres
rows.evidence: Nearest-feature promotion is prohibited without a recorded transformation and exact relation.

rows.value: Current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK intervention plans
rows.evidence: Current and future states must remain separate from Ofcom current-r2 coverage.

rows.value: Current claim may be unverified or planned build may retain evidence/delivery risk
rows.evidence: Under Review cannot be promoted to current broadband availability.
